Huntloc is a real-time hunting, tracking and management app for hunting teams and provides tracking devices for hunting dogs. You can see the movement of hunting dogs and other hunters on your smartphone, share information between hunters and create your own hunting map.

Tracking a common hunt is easy
One of the members of the hunt starts hunting on his or her phone and receives a unique code. Other hunters join the hunt using this code. This creates a hunting team whose movement is visible on the phone map. When the owner of a hunting dog with a Huntloc tracking device joins the hunt, all participants will also be able to see the dog's location. 
Hunting with Huntloc is more effective, safer and more fun
•	While on a common hunt, your phone shows the current location of dogs and hunters, the direction of movement, the pace of movement, and the distance traveled. Hunting and dog tracking are unlimited in distance.
•	During the hunt, you can send messages to the participants and share the location of the various hunting events on the map (e.g., a caught game, an animal track, etc.). Plus, you can quickly call any hunter.
•	The different maps of Google and the Estonian Land Board and the hunting objects recorded by the hunter themselves (e.g., animal feeding places and other hunting-related locations and areas) give an accurate overview of the hunting ground. You can share your hunting objects with other Huntloc users. 
•	When navigating in the hunt, you can set a navigation target and then use the compass view to arrive at the desired location by the shortest route.
•	A 24-hour weather forecast with sunrise and sunset time will help you plan your hunt. You can view the weather forecast for your own location or for a location selected on the map.
•	Huntloc's portal.huntloc.com can be used for viewing the hunts you have participated in and for more convenient drawing of the hunting card.

The location of a dog with the Huntloc tracking device can be seen on your smartphone
The Huntloc tracking device provides a very accurate position of the dog in the terrain. The tracking device uses the mobile network and has no distance limitation - the dog can be tracked from thousands of kilometers away. All you need is a smartphone to monitor your dog and control your device. In addition to tracking, you can call the dog, listen to the dog's activities and give voice commands. Keeping the device constantly on the dog's neck, it acts as a security device and can be switched on from a distance when the dog is lost. 

The tracking device is very strong, lightweight, waterproof and has a long service life. The monitoring time is 36 hours (10 seconds interval) and the standby time is 1 month. In order to ensure waterproofing, there are no openings or buttons on the unit, and the 3 indicator lights indicate the unit's operating status. The device is charged wirelessly.

TRANSPark helps commercial drivers and road transport fleet managers easily find and add secure and comfortable parking areas in over 60+ countries worldwide. It was created to prevent freight and fuel theft by listing security features available for each parking area, as well as listing available amenities to improve driver comfort while on duty. 

With TRANSPark, you can:
Search, locate and contact parking areas and fuel stations:
 - Near you, up to 400km away
 - Along your planned itinerary

Search for or select parking areas based on:
 - Security levels (cameras, dangerous goods accepted, 24/7 guard, fences, flood lighting)
 - Comfort levels (fuel station, sanitary facilities, hotel, restaurant/buffet, coffee shop, medical assistance, electric connection, vehicle repair, vehicle wash)

Contribute and help other drivers:
 - Add your favourite parking areas that are not yet available in the app
 - Update or add information on a parking area
 - Rate and share your experience on parking areas you visit

Saphe Link is the official app for your Saphe traffic alarm. 
 
Avoid accidents and speeding fines 
 
A traffic alarm from Saphe not only helps you avoid speeding tickets, but increases your safety and reduces the time you spend in traffic.   
 
Saphe traffic alarm  
 
With a traffic alarm from Saphe you gain a wealth of benefits:  
 
•    Accurate alerts about speed cameras, accidents and dangers on the road.  
•    Starts up automatically with your car.  
•    Quick and secure operation.  
•    You become part of a traffic community of more than 11 million users.  
•    Works abroad where you gain access to approx. 100,000 fixed speed cameras.  
 
Saphe Premium subscription  

Saphe Premium gives you access to additional features:  
 
•    Speed limit display. 
•    Speeding assistant. 
•    Route navigation. 
•    Apple CarPlay. 
 
At the same time, your subscription ensures that you will continue to receive the latest updates and features. The new Saphe Drive Pro traffic alert requires a paid subscription to Saphe Premium. 

Saphe Premium can also be combined with older models such as Saphe One+ and Saphe Drive Mini. 
 
Getting started  
 
•   Download the Saphe Link app.  
•    Create a user account. 
•    Connect the traffic alarm to your smartphone via Bluetooth. 
•    Activate/create a subscription for Saphe Premium (required for Pro). If you have a starter pack, the traffic alarm is already set up with a 12-month subscription. 
•   Place the traffic alarm in the car within sight and reach. 
 
Please note that: 
- to be able to start automatically, Saphe Link needs access to your location, while the app is in the background.  
- continuous use of GPS in the background may drain your battery faster than normal. 
 
One of Europe’s largest traffic communities  
 
As a Saphe user, you become part of a community with data from over 11 million road users across Europe, helping each other to save lives, time and money. 

Saphe gets traffic data from partners all over Europe and the community is growing all the time. Saphe has data partners in Germany, Finland, Spain, the Netherlands and Belgium. 
 
Customise Saphe Link to your needs  
 
Select the alerts that are important to you. When you have ensured that you only receive the alerts that are applicable to you, you will be able to set alert times, alert information and tone etc.  
 
Lightning fast communication 

Saphe Link enables motorists to communicate with each other quickly and efficiently by sharing data about everything that happens on the road. This form of communication can make a significant difference, with the goal of reducing the number of accidents in traffic. If an incident occurs on your route that you need to pay attention to, you will be informed quickly thanks to the active community of motorists. You can also help them by reporting traffic incidents yourself. The traffic data is updated in real time to ensure a high quality of the latest warnings. 
 
Find out more about Saphe at www.saphe.com
